content.text: I'm the person behind **bigbi**, shaping its direction, design, and technology.

I've been building for the web for more than eight years, working with businesses across Europe and Australia, with much of my experience focused on the German market. My background spans Magento, WordPress, Shopify, Linux, cloud infrastructure, UI/UX, and frontend engineering, giving me a deep understanding of the web from its fundamentals to modern digital experiences.

Today, I focus on creating modern UI/UX experiences and building them with Next.js, bringing together thoughtful design, solid engineering, performance, and a long-term perspective. **bigbi** is an extension of how I like to work — going deep into the details, keeping things simple, and creating digital experiences that are clear, reliable, and built to last.
Built with depth. Made to last.
We care about the details, the foundations, and the experience long after launch.
